body:
`task_session` returns `plain_session` when the starting project is plain, even when another project in the task holds symbols. The observed root task (scope `.` and `solace-cli`) starts in `.`, so its brief lists no Rust symbols and no `RUST_BRIEF`.

1. Build the task's other-project list before the plain check. Return `plain_session` only when no project in the task's scope has symbols.
2. Build `Modules` from every included project, each group headed by its folder; add `RUST_BRIEF` when any included project is Rust.
3. Keep the symbol packet's `(<folder>)` markers and the `inspect <name> --project <folder>` hint.
4. Tests: a task scoped `.` + `solace-cli` starts in `.` and its brief lists `solace-cli`'s Rust modules and symbols and the Rust brief; a task with only plain projects still gets `plain_session`; a Gleam project with a Rust sibling includes both.

Checks: `rust-unit`, `rust-board-tests`, `rust-acceptance`.
title: session: include every task project
